title: PARADIGMS IN PHYSICS: STATIC FIELDS
description: Focuses on theory of static electric, magnetic, and gravitational potentials and fields using the techniques of vector calculus in three dimensions.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (PH 213 or 213H) and PH 335* and (MTH 255* or 255H*).
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C- is required in PH 213, PH 213H, PH 335, MTH 255 and MTH 255H.
